title.narrative: Balochistan Water Resources Development Sector Project - Additional Financing

description.narrative: The ongoing project aims to improve (i) land and water resources management, agricultural productivity, and farm income in Balochistan; and (ii) the institutional capacity of the Government of Balochistan (GOB) to implement its integrated water resources management policy.

description.narrative: Agricultural productivity in the project area increased

In Mula river basin, crop yield increased to 3,750 kg/ha for citrus; 2,700 kg/ha for wheat; 1,800 kg/ha for cotton; and 11,000 kg/ha for winter fodders (2014 baselines: 3,000 kg/ha for citrus; 2,224 kg/ha for wheat; 1,277 kg/ha for cotton; and 9,000 kg/ha for winter fodders) (OP5.3) Data Source: Government of Balochistan's yearly agriculture statistics and/or survey reports Baseline value: 3000,2224,1277,9000

In Zhob river basin, crop yield increased to 5,400 kg/ha for apricots; 2,500 kg/ha for wheat; 8,900 kg/ha for hybrid maize (corn); and 10,500 kg/ha for winter fodders (2014 baselines: 4,500 kg/ha for apricots, 2,031 kg/ha for wheat, 7,413 kg/ha for hybrid maize, and 8,500 kg/ha for winter fodders) (OP5.3) Data Source: Government of Balochistan's yearly agriculture statistics and/or survey reports Baseline value: 4500,2031,7413,8500
